newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: CM Telecom invests US$9.2 mln in GSM deal.
newsitem.headline: CM Telecom invests US$9.2 mln in GSM deal.

text.p: Hong Kong-based CM Telecom International Ltd said on Tuesday it was investing US$9.15 million in a Global System for Mobile Telecommunications (GSM) project in Guangdong, China.

The company said in a statement it had set up CM Mobile Telecom (Hong Kong) Company Ltd (CMM) with several investment partners to undertake the project with China Motion Telecom Development Co (CMTD).

CMTD, a state-owned company, provides paging services within the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone and Pearl River Delta region as well as major cities in China. It is CM Telecom's largest customer and partner in other projects in China.
CMM will be wholly-owned by CM Mobile Telecom Holdings Ltd (CMMTH), which would in turn be 51.86 percent owned by CM Mobile Investment Ltd, a joint venture between CM Telecom and CMTD.
The other shareholders of CMMTH are Asiavest Investment Management, Capital International Walden Group, Nichimen Corp and Suez Asia, the statement said.
The partners would advance a loan of US$46.6 million to CMMTH, it added.
